operations.title: AI queue and operations
operations.subtitle: Real-time status of PostgreSQL, Redis, Ollama, and MongoDB. Each job keeps traceability through email, execution, attempt, and model.
operations.refreshTooltip: Check the status now without waiting for the next 3-second cycle.
operations.loadError: Could not retrieve AI queue status.
operations.actionError: The AI operation could not be completed.
operations.helpText: Redis transports events, PostgreSQL keeps the durable queue, MongoDB stores history, and Ollama runs the model. Maintenance actions do not remove the durable queue except Remove, which cancels one specific job.
operations.cancelJobMessage: Request {requestId} will be cancelled and will not be sent to the model. The record is retained for traceability.
operations.cancelJobSuccessMessage: The job will no longer be sent to the model.
operations.retrySuccessMessage: The job will be processed by AI again.
operations.clearRedisMessage: Acknowledges and removes messages from dhole.ai.events that have been delivered to the consumer group without ACK for more than one hour. Durable PostgreSQL jobs are not removed.
operations.clearRedisSuccessMessage: Only old pending messages from the consumer group were removed.
operations.trimRedisMessage: Reduces dhole.ai.events to an approximate window of 10,000 recent events. The durable PostgreSQL queue is not removed.
operations.trimRedisSuccessMessage: Redis kept the most recent stream window.
operations.purgeMongoMessage: Deletes AI execution snapshots older than 90 days. MongoDB is used as history; this action does not delete PostgreSQL jobs or new Redis messages.
operations.unidentifiedModelMessage: There is no visible execution that can relate this loaded model to its Dhole ModelId.
operations.unloadMessage: Releases the model from Ollama RAM/VRAM. It does not delete the model from disk; it will load again automatically when an execution needs it.
operations.unloadSuccessMessage: {model} was requested to be unloaded from Ollama memory.
